_doc: What each card's media window shows, in order (the window microcuts between items every 2-4 s; items split the card's on-screen time evenly unless 'beats' is given). 'receipt' = index into the case's receipts (real screenshot of the source, labelled SOURCE); 'anim' = an original animation from src/media (labelled ILLUSTRATIVE). 'word' = start this item 6 frames before the narration first says that word in the card's segment (reel only; the carousel splits evenly).
